introduction.en: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.
introduction.hi: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.

body.en: Cost-push inflation occurs when the costs of production increase, forcing producers to raise prices to maintain margins. In India, this is often driven by rising global crude oil prices, supply chain disruptions, and wage-price spirals. These factors reduce aggregate supply, creating inflationary pressure.
body.hi: Cost-push inflation occurs when the costs of production increase, forcing producers to raise prices to maintain margins. In India, this is often driven by rising global crude oil prices, supply chain disruptions, and wage-price spirals. These factors reduce aggregate supply, creating inflationary pressure.

conclusion.en: Managing cost-push inflation requires structural reforms in supply chains and energy security, alongside prudent monetary policy to anchor inflation expectations.
